harness: receive-path v2: raw TS bytes + per-datagram arrival timestamps + byte offsets, per-run directory
harness_prevalidated: yes - probe-program showed 600 video packets/19.66s, contiguous index, decodable frames+captions
procedure: 1. channel STOPPED; start receiver (capture begins before enable)
2. issue START at a logged wall time
4. controlled STOP then START at logged times
5. keep SAME receiver running through >= 120s post-recovery
7. tie the recovery boundary to DATAGRAM ARRIVAL (stream gap/resume), not to PTS
8. decode; apply six-word rule ONLY within the arrival-proven post-recovery interval
success_criteria: receiver captures the whole run in ONE uninterrupted index
arrival timeline shows the stop gap and the resume
>=1 real program cue matches decoded text WITHIN the arrival-proven post-recovery interval
failure_criteria: no decoded text after recovery -> FAIL
arrival boundary cannot be identified -> report unproven
unchanged: max_backlog_segments=2 and the 120s fail-closed are NOT modified. No synthetic cue injection.
